title: Empagliflozin and cardiovascular outcomes in adults with type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial
abstract: We randomly assigned 7020 adults with type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease to receive empagliflozin 10 mg or 25 mg or matching placebo once daily. The primary composite outcome was death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke. Over a median follow-up of 3.1 years, the primary outcome occurred in fewer patients in the empagliflozin group than in the placebo group.

title: SGLT2 inhibition in adolescents with type 2 diabetes: a randomized pilot study
abstract: Forty-eight adolescents aged 12 to 17 years with type 2 diabetes were randomized to receive dapagliflozin or placebo for 26 weeks. The primary endpoint was change in HbA1c; cardiovascular events were recorded as adverse events.

title: Canagliflozin use and cardiovascular events in routine clinical practice: a retrospective cohort study
abstract: Using a nationwide health insurance claims database, we identified adults with type 2 diabetes who initiated canagliflozin or a DPP-4 inhibitor between 2015 and 2019. In this retrospective cohort study, the primary outcome was hospitalization for heart failure, compared using propensity score matching.

title: Effect of ertugliflozin on glycemic control in type 2 diabetes: a randomized trial
abstract: Adults with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on metformin were randomized to ertugliflozin or placebo for 26 weeks. The primary endpoint was the change in HbA1c from baseline. Secondary endpoints included fasting plasma glucose and body weight.

title: Dapagliflozin versus placebo in patients with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes: a randomized trial
abstract: We enrolled 500 adults with type 2 diabetes or prediabetes and randomly assigned them to dapagliflozin 10 mg or placebo. The composite cardiovascular outcome of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure was assessed over 2 years.

title: Sotagliflozin versus placebo on cardiovascular death and heart failure hospitalization in type 2 diabetes: a double-blind randomized trial
abstract: In this double-blind trial, 1222 adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease were randomly assigned to sotagliflozin or placebo. The primary end point was the composite of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure.

title: Sotagliflozin versus placebo on cardiovascular death and heart failure hospitalization in type 2 diabetes: a double blind randomised trial
abstract: A total of 1222 adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease were randomly assigned to receive sotagliflozin or placebo in this double-blind trial. The primary end point was the composite of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure. Follow-up lasted a median of 16 months.
